title: Dutch Beef Stew
description: A hearty beef stew with a rich and flavorful broth. Perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, carrot, and potato, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the stew, tomato paste, and browned beef to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
